name: League of Legends
author: Aura
description: Shows your League of Legends queue, champion, skin, KDA and party on your profile. Nothing to set up.
uses: Whether League of Legends is running
The Riot Client's local connection on your PC (its lockfile), for your game state, champion, skin and rank
The League client's local connection on your PC (its lockfile), for your party size
League's live game data on your PC, for your KDA, CS and game time
CommunityDragon, for queue, champion, skin and rank names and pictures
